conceptZh: 河是從高處流向海的長長的水
object: a chunky toy warrior and a tiny hippo copycat
morph: the hippo mimics the warrior one beat late and the splash makes the strokes of 河
creativeAngle: 玩具戰士跳過河，小河馬慢一拍模仿，每次水花畫出一筆。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 河 (river). Lead: a stout toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield, bravado high and skill low. Moment 1 (0-1.7s): he strides to the bank and leaps; the voice says 河 as he splashes in belly first. Moment 2 (1.7-3.4s): a small gray hippo mimics each pose one beat late, striking the pond; the splashes freeze into blue strokes making 河 on the second 河. Moment 3 (3.4-5.3s): the warrior swings his foam sword, the hippo copies late and bumps his shield; as the voice says 河馬 the hippo yawns wide and the shield falls into its mouth. Moment 4 (5.3-8s): glyph still; the pair bow together, the hippo blowing a tiny water spout. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "河、河、河馬" (ㄏㄜˊ、ㄏㄜˊ、ㄏㄜˊ ㄇㄚˇ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 河, drawn as saturated solid medium blue strokes on a pale warm yellow background, correctly formed, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins, perfectly still for the final 3-second hold while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
